answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, expired if not renewed by fresh work. The vault lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the tide is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
